relations: Gravity elongates the thin liquid strands hanging from each nozzle tip.
Droplets at strand ends detach and fall when surface tension can no longer support their weight.
Continuous flow from the manifold sustains the hanging strands as they stretch downward.
High viscosity slows breakup, letting strands remain intact and threadlike between droplets.
